**Trader consensus at 100% for 31°C reflects the Korea Meteorological Administration’s (KMA) official observations and near-real-time data confirming Busan’s daily maximum reached exactly that value on August 12, 2026.** 

Mid-August conditions under the North Pacific High typically produce highs of 29–32°C along the southeastern coast, with sea breezes moderating extremes compared to inland areas. Recent model runs and hourly KMA updates aligned on this narrow range, and live surface observations during peak heating hours locked in the 31°C peak without exceeding it. 

The market’s near-certain positioning mirrors this verified measurement, as Polymarket resolves on authoritative KMA records rather than forecasts. A realistic challenge would require a post-event data revision (rare) or an uncharacteristic late-day spike from localized heating or measurement error, but current atmospheric stability and observational agreement make such shifts improbable.
